_comment: GEARED (engine-v3) copy of the engine-v2 file: items added, reckless-gale replaced by the Heron Fan's art wind-heron-takes-wing, gale-sprite replaced by the Slow-Hour Needle's art wind-stitch-the-hour, item Effects Echo, Wind at Your Back and Phantom Dodge written as engine Effects.
